title: Kharaqan Towers
visualBrief: Specific paired Kharaqan mausoleums at one archaeological site: two separate mapped octagonal brick masses/rounded corner shafts, tall recessed pointed fields, original broad geometric brick relief and upper friezes, shallow curved brick caps with real lower slots. Distinguish the more ornate eastern panels from the western panels and restrained stabilizing struts. Small separate grade-seated brick footings; no platform across the gap or entire archaeological-site replacement. No copied inscriptions, image atlas, furnished tomb chambers or restored perfect sealed roofs.
